results.title: Vivre encore
results.overview: At the crucial moment when autonomy is lost, the question arises for older adults, their families, caregivers, and those who support them: What should be done with the time constantly gained over death? Within the confined spaces of homes or the cramped rooms of nursing homes, conflicts arise, losses and acts of solidarity play out, and bonds of tenderness and joy form—all of which speak to the richness and depth of life’s long journey. Behind the hushed silences, the apparent stillness, and the slow pace, new spaces open up to be explored…

results.title: 11 χρόνια δίκη Χρυσή Αυγή - ΟΙ ΑΝΘΡΩΠΟΙ ΤΗΣ
results.original_title: 11 χρόνια δίκη Χρυσή Αυγή - ΟΙ ΑΝΘΡΩΠΟΙ ΤΗΣ
results.overview: Eleven years have passed since that 20th of April 2015, when the curtain opened on one of the most significant trials in modern Greek history. A long legal battle that concluded with the final, definitive recognition of Golden Dawn as a criminal organization, vindicating the victims and all those who persisted in the pursuit of truth and justice.

results.title: Jamie Foxx: Take Care of Yourself
results.original_title: Jamie Foxx: Take Care of Yourself
results.overview: Jamie Foxx delivers honest self-care comedy in "Take Care of Yourself." He joins the "Hularious" lineup with Hannah Berner, Ralph Barbosa, Bill Burr, Chris Distefano, Jim Gaffigan, Zarna Garg, Nikki Glaser, Ilana Glazer and more.

results.title: Kamal's
results.overview: In rural Iowa, a Muslim chef and his Catholic wife fuse their cultures in the kitchen and beyond, serving dishes that blend Middle Eastern tradition with Midwestern bounty. But their greatest recipe is for belonging, as they build a community where everyone has a seat at the table.

results.title: Видеопрокат
results.overview: The steady, uneventful life of Roma, a lonely ninth-grader, is disrupted by Polina—a rebellious older student who is constantly getting into wild escapades. Together, they attempt to unravel the mystery of a mystical VHS tape—number seven—rented from a local video store. Drawn into a dangerous adventure and growing genuinely close, they have no idea what kind of choice the investigation’s conclusion will force them to make.

results.title: SB19 Wakas at Simula: The Trilogy Concert Finale
results.original_title: SB19 Wakas at Simula: The Trilogy Concert Finale
results.overview: From unforgettable stages to a journey shared with A’TIN,  SB19 brings it all to the big screen.  The most awaited finale is coming to cinemas worldwide.

results.title: Pequeño diccionario de gramática de las nubes
results.original_title: Pequeño diccionario de gramática de las nubes
results.overview: Young participants in Escuela Dentro Cine make a collective visual alphabet, using self-filming and the image of clouds to explore freedom, rebellion and their own ways of seeing.

results.title: Taísa Machado — In a State of Encounter
results.original_title: Taísa Machado - Em Estado de Encontro
results.overview: The film unfolds through a series of encounters: Taísa revisiting her personal archives and engaging in conversations with family members, friends, and mentors.

results.title: Semiarid Paradise
results.overview: In 2007, while filming the documentary O Tempo e o Lugar, Genivaldo Vieira da Silva, known as Geno, a former activist with the Pastoral Land Commission, the Landless Workers’ Movement (MST), and the Workers’ Party (PT), said he intended to move within three years from Inhapi, Alagoas, where he had always lived, to his property in Santa Brígida, Bahia, which he described as his “paradise.”  Seventeen years later, Genivaldo had still not made the move to his promised land. The documentary seeks to understand why, while also exploring Geno’s spiritual side and the reasons behind his new political choices.

results.title: Watsky x Infinity
results.overview: "Watsky x Infinity" is the visual film for the album "x Infinity". The 2016 visual album by rapper and poet George Watsky features 18 interconnected music videos for each song on his album of the same name.

results.title: All Yours
results.overview: After discovering her skin is peeling off, a bored mother is compelled to bake it into little pastries.

results.title: Calming Winds
results.overview: Struggling with his smoking addiction, Rich has to quit smoking before his partner Char leaves him. Searching on the internet for solutions he finds a peculiar pop up add that'll grant him his wish, by removing Rich's ability to create a flame.

results.title: Cinderella of Samba
results.overview: Célio, a regular at samba circles, falls in love with a beautiful and mysterious woman who is always singing at the edge of the circle. Every time he tries to approach her she disappears, always at the same time.

results.title: Cadu Barcellos: Legends never die, they live forever
results.original_title: Cadu Barcellos - Cria não morre, vira lenda
results.overview: This documentary celebrates Cadu Barcellos, a Black filmmaker from the Maré favela complex. In defiance of erasure, the film moves beyond tragedy to celebrate his light, ancestry, and legacy.

results.title: In Winter
results.overview: Gabit, a physics teacher and father of five, is struggling to make ends meet when he happens upon a bag containing a large sum of cash buried in the snow-covered field outside his apartment building. Suddenly his life becomes comfortable, with him repaying bank loans and treating his family to expensive meals and gifts. But anxiety over where the money came from soon begins to weigh on him.

results.title: Baile das Luzes
results.overview: A sensory immersion into the long-term projects of photographer Vincent Rosenblatt, a Parisian who has been based in Rio de Janeiro for more than 20 years. The film explores the worlds of Rio’s funk scene, the bate-bola carnival celebrations, and the sound-system parties of Belém do Pará, while also including a journey through Poland. In this polyphonic voyage, he unveils his visual obsessions and reveals a perpetual state of searching, in which life, image, and catharsis become intertwined.
